Kit summary

Mystic RuyiBasic
Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single enemy. Afterward, there is a 90% chance to inflict [ATK Down Ⅱ] or [SPD Down Ⅱ] on the target for 2 turns, prioritizing inflicting the attribute debuff not owned by the target.
Ruyi SplendorActiveExclusive Lv.3
Restores the selected ally's HP by 8.4% of Aniru's Max HP. If the ally does not have [Heal], additionally grants them 1 layer of [Heal] for 2 turns. If the ally is from the Sagacity Alliance, additionally restores 50 Stance value for the ally.
Verdant Ruyi Lv.3Ruyi Splendor: Grants effect to allies other than the selected target: If HP is not full: restores HP by 40% of the main target's HP restored. If HP is full: increases Turn Meters by 5%.
Auspicious RuyiPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Aniru has a 40% chance to block control effects. This effect does not occur when she is under [Stance Broken] status and this chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES. Each time Aniru casts Ruyi Splendor, she gains 1 layer of [Light of Verdancy]. When [Light of Verdancy] is stacked to 6 layers, Aniru will consume all of them immediately to grant all allies a [Shield] equal to 25% of her Max HP and increase all allies' Turn Meters by 8%.
Verdant Ruyi Lv.2Auspicious Ruyi: Grants a [Shield] equal to 45% of Aniru's Max HP and increases all allies' Turn Meter by 15% instead. When [Charm of Nature] reaches the upper limit, each exceeded layer of [Charm of Nature] obtained will be converted into [Light of Verdancy].
Verdant NatureActiveExclusive Lv.1
Restores all allies' HP by 16% of Aniru's Max HP and self Stance value by 20% of Max Stance value. Afterward, gains 6 layers of [Charm of Nature], up to 10 layers can be owned. At the beginning of any ally's turn, if the ally does not have full HP and Aniru has [Charm of Nature], consumes 1 layer immediately to cast Ruyi Splendor on the ally for once. Aniru loses all layers of [Charm of Nature] after entering [Stance Broken] status.
Verdant Ruyi Lv.1Increases Aniru's Max Stance value by 500. Each time she is back to [Parry] status from [Stance Broken] status and at the beginning of each wave, restores her Stance value to the upper limit. Also, at the beginning of each wave, Aniru casts Verdant Nature automatically for once and reduces the CD of all allies' all skills by 1 turn.
Source: game files.
